description: Discover the Paris of ArtistsIn an exceptional apartment on three levels in the rare historic environment of Quincampoix street in the heart of the Marais.Come live and share the atmosphere of historic Paris, the unique experience of a dream holiday that combines both the charm of old stones, beams and original timber and the well being of modern comfort, like the Pompidou Beaubourg Cultural Center, which dominates the neighborhood with all its architectural power.❤️🤩❤️The space8 GUESTS, 6 BEDS, 4 BEDROOMS*2 BEDROOMS EACH WITH A DOUBLE BED*2 BEDROOMS WITH TWO SINGLE BEDS THAT CAN BE JOINED INTO DOUBLE BEDSDiscover this exceptional apartment on three levels located in the rare historic environment of Quincampoix street in the heart of the old Marais de ParisQuincampoix street is known to be the oldest street in Paris.It dates from the 12th century and was first of all a place of trade and exchange between the clothiers from the East and the richest Merciers of Paris whose activity at the time was grouped around Notre Dame. It evolved to a place of walk for the Aristocrats and was at the origin of an upheaval of the royal finances when, in 1719 settled there John Law who created there the first World General Bank, which revolutionized the world of the businesses.Come to live and share with family or friends in the atmosphere of historic Paris, the unique experience of a dream holiday in an apartment that combines both the charm of the old with its old stones, its beams , its original frescoes and half-timberings and the well-being of a modern comfort, like the Notre Dame de Paris cathedral and Pompidou Beaubourg Cultural Center which dominates the district with all its architectural power.The place has been completely revisited by Parisian interior designers to be moderni

enrichment.summary: Historic Marais apartment on three levels, with 4 bedrooms and an explicitly described layout of 2 double beds plus 4 singles. One guest places the kitchen and dining room below the street-level bedrooms, so internal stairs are needed to reach the kitchen.

photoReview.bestPhotoReason: Strong, well-lit view of the distinctive vaulted dining room and its large table, clearly showing the home's historic character.
issues: Only one bathroom is pictured in the reviewed photos; one review independently describes two shower and WC areas, including one below street level.
One review places the kitchen and dining room below the street-level bedrooms and bathroom; internal stairs are needed to reach the kitchen.

themes: Several reviews praise the distinctive historic character and interiors.
Several reviews describe the location as central and convenient for walking, transit and restaurants.
Several reviews praise responsive, helpful hosts.
concerns: One reviewed stay places the kitchen and dining room on the lower level, so internal stairs are needed for kitchen access.
